items.description: Kindamba is a town in Pool south-west of Brazzaville. It serves as a rural center for the surrounding communities and local administration.
Boko is a town in Pool close to Brazzaville. It belongs to the capital's wider rural belt and supports nearby farming areas.
Louingui is a small town in Pool south of Brazzaville. It has a local role in transport, trade, and village supply.
Loudima is a town in Bouenza in south-central Congo. It lies along the main transport corridor between Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire.
Souanké is a town in Sangha in northern Congo. Its position near the border gives it a clear role as a frontier settlement.
Okoyo is a small town in Cuvette-Ouest in north-western Congo. It is a rural stop for the local road network and nearby villages.
Mpouya is a town in the Plateaux department of central Congo. It sits along the inland route toward the Congo River basin.
Ngo is a town in Plateaux in central Congo. It is a known stop on National Road 2 between Brazzaville and the north.
Allembé is a small town in the Plateaux department of central Congo. It has a local agricultural and trading role in the region.
Dongou is a town in Likouala in northern Congo. It lies in a river landscape shaped by wetlands and slow-moving waterways.
Epéna is a town in Likouala in the far north of Congo. It is a remote local center in a region dominated by forest and swamp.
Betou is a river town in Likouala near the Ubangi corridor. Its location gives it cross-border importance in far northern Congo.
